summary: PolyPid Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting a License and Supply Agreement with Azurity Pharmaceuticals Ireland Ltd. for exclusive commercialization of D-PLEX 100 in the US and Canada. Terms include a $15M upfront payment, $15M milestone upon FDA acceptance of NDA (expected August 2026), up to ~$300M in additional milestones, tiered royalties (mid-teen to mid-twenties), and transfer price for manufacturing. PolyPid retains global rights outside territory, manufacturing rights, and ownership of PLEX platform. The agreement expires after 20 years. This is a licensing deal, not a full acquisition or divestiture; watch for FDA decision and milestone triggers.
